summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) using wave-based parallel worktree execution across 5 plans, then run post-execution gates including code review.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans completed and merged with build/typecheck clean and 93+ targeted tests passing. Code review found 2 confirmed blockers (missing cycle guard in collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync, missing .catch() on 4 dispatch sites) requiring fixes before phase can ship.

repo: pnpm/orval api:generate in a worktree resolves to the workspace root, not the worktree — running it inside any worktree leaks 132 regenerated api-client files into the main checkout
Husky regenerates .husky/_/* stubs in worktrees when pnpm install/generate runs; these untracked files block the cleanup-wave helper's dirty-check
The cleanup-wave merge helper silently fails (leaves MERGE_HEAD) when the pre-commit hook (eslint+prettier across 137 staged files) is slow — requires manual git commit completion
The gsd_run query commit helper has a known false-negative: reports commit_failed but the commit actually lands — always verify with git log
The init.manager dep-string parser mis-parses 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into phantom phase '1.1', falsely marking deps as unsatisfied; real dep Phase 49 was complete
Two orphaned worktree-agent-* branches (a92edd36, abd7998d) exist from a prior session with no attached worktrees
pre-commit hook runs check-api-client.sh + pnpm lint-staged (eslint --fix + prettier on generated files); no post-merge hook but post-commit/post-rewrite hooks exist
The repo has run 151 plans across 34 completed phases using parallel worktree execution as the standard mainline path

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync has no visited set for cycle detection despite recursing at lines 220/246/316 and its docstring claiming to mirror ensureFolderLoaded DFS pattern — folder cycle causes unbounded recursion, directly violating phase data-integrity goal
4 fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites use .then() with no .catch() — unhandled rejections silently swallowed
ensureFolderLoaded correctly carries a visited set for DFS cycle guard — the pattern collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync was supposed to mirror but didn't
Refcount guard added here in 50-02: skips physical unpin during drain when CID is re-pinned (WR-03 fix)
fileUnpins.inc() now gated by rowDeleted flag (IN-01); recordUnpin removed as dead code with zero callers (IN-03); outboxRowInserted renamed to shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin (IN-06)
Upload compensation catch now calls ipfsProvider.unpinFile(result.cid) directly for WR-02 — guardedUnpin bypassed because it returns early with no DB row

workflow: When worktrees share a pnpm workspace, code-generation commands (pnpm api:generate) must be quarantined or run only from the main checkout — verify leaked files match the worktree before discarding them
Manual merge recovery when cleanup-wave leaves MERGE_HEAD: verify no unmerged paths, then git commit with hooks enabled (generous timeout for lint-staged over large generated file sets)
Post-merge gate should be targeted (changed packages only), not full monorepo parallel — prevents RAM starvation and avoids infra-dependent integration tests
Key-links in pre-wave dependency checks can false-positive on forward-references to the upcoming wave's own deliverables — validate against actual source before treating as a blocker
Code review blockers can appear in new code added by the phase itself (CR-01 was in 50-03's new traversal) — always confirm blockers against source before proceeding to verify/ship

friction: init.manager mis-parsed 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as phantom phase '1.1', causing false unsatisfied-dep display on dashboard
Husky regenerating .husky/_/* stubs in the 50-05 worktree blocked cleanup-wave's dirty-check; required manual inspection and restore before retry
api-client (132 files) and sdk/client.ts leaked from worktrees into main checkout because pnpm resolves to workspace root — needed manual diff verification before discarding
cleanup-wave silently left MERGE_HEAD when pre-commit hook took too long on 137 staged files — required diagnosing via git status and completing merge manually
gsd commit helper false-negative (reports commit_failed, commit actually lands) required git log verification after every tracking commit
build output truncation during post-merge typecheck masked exit code — required a second clean run to confirm exit 0
The macro-level dep string in ROADMAP for Phase 49 is ambiguous enough to fool the parser — a structural issue that will recur on similarly-formatted deps
